native_task.state: normalized logical spinor, encoded return image and full source/command archive
native_task.operations: the24 retained binary tetrahedral logical rotations

native_task.square: For A=epsilon E_a,B=eta E_b,a!=b, AB=-BA; comparison is -I, not an equality of full amplitudes.
native_task.cost: formal token c_native(U) per applied logical matrix; numeric primitive implementation cost unassigned

chart_task.state: fixed reference spinor and a marked vertex u in {-1,0,1}^3, value C(u)z_ref, encoded image, full edge archive
chart_task.guard: current vertex equals edge source; both endpoints are grid vertices and differ by one unit along one coordinate
chart_task.native_only_mode: admit the edge iff T(v,u) belongs to the native24 matrices
chart_task.supplied_grid_mode: admit all declared grid edges as conditional supplied operations, including nonnative matrices
chart_task.comparison: Composed chart transports telescope on equal vertex endpoints; different edge archives remain distinct.
chart_task.cost: c_native(T) for native matrices, c_supplied(T) for nonnative matrices; sum formal tokens along the actual route, no cancellation or shared-cost credit without an explicit implementation
chart_task.boundary: The finite grid task is not every SU(2) operation and does not share the native task's enabled domains.

source_protocol_support.interpretation: fixed stored coefficient protocol support, not the per-command cost of U, W_U or a chart edge

cost_semantics.identification: exact matrices may share a formal token; distinct executions still contribute one occurrence each
cost_semantics.inverse_routes: recover state but retain both execution tokens and history
cost_semantics.forbidden_inference: endpoint equality, coordinate status or group membership alone never assigns cost144 or zero
